name: Google Analytics (GA4)
description: Marketing, SEO and the Chief of Staff read your GA4 properties: traffic, channels, conversions, revenue and realtime. Connect with your Google account in the browser.
author: REX

connections.name: Google Analytics
connections.description: Marketing, SEO and the Chief of Staff read your GA4 properties: traffic, channels, conversions, revenue and realtime. Connect with your Google account in the browser.
connections.authCommand: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/share/google-cloud-sdk/bin:/usr/local/share/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$HOME/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH"; command -v gcloud >/dev/null || { echo "Installing Google Cloud CLI (one time)…"; brew install --cask google-cloud-sdk; }; gcloud auth application-default login --scopes=openid,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly && node "${rex:bin}/rex-google-mcp.mjs" --setup
connections.setupHint: Click Connect with Google: your browser opens Google's sign-in. Approve, and REX sets up the rest (Cloud project + APIs) automatically. First time only, REX installs the Google Cloud CLI.

commands.title: Marketing: Weekly GA4 traffic report
commands.prompt: Using Google Analytics, build last week's traffic report: sessions, users, conversions by channel and top landing pages vs the previous week. End with 3 actions.
